stemMd: Four products have mass and volume: J 12 g, 4 cm³; K 15 g, 5 cm³; L 18 g, 9 cm³; M 20 g, 4 cm³. Which has the greatest density?
explanationMd: Density is mass divided by volume. The four values are 3, 3, 2 and 5 g cm⁻³. M therefore has the greatest density. Neither the largest mass nor the smallest volume alone is a complete criterion, though M combines both here.

distractorRationale.e: Its density is 3 g cm⁻³, below M’s density.
distractorRationale.a: Its density is also 3 g cm⁻³.
distractorRationale.c: Its density is 2 g cm⁻³ despite its relatively large mass.
distractorRationale.b: They tie with each other but not for the maximum.
